mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly demand (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the monthly supply index (INDPRO) reflects robust production capacity, which reduces supply-side bottlenecks and supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO trends upward.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, signaling monetary tightening, discount rates on equities rise, reducing present value of future cash flows and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant rises in the federal funds rate above 4.0% and unemployment above 5.0% create a contractionary environment, tightening financial conditions and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when both proxies meet the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS >4% and CPIAUCSL <2%), elevated interest rates compress discount rates on equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not negative in tightening cycles despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 indicates strong labor market expansion, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS crosses above 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high demand (GDPC1 >100) and low unemployment (UNRATE <4%), robust economic growth and low inflation create favorable conditions for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive in late-cycle expansions despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: High demand (HOUST >1200 units) coupled with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <0.4%) signals expansionary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies meet the trigger.
